## 📦 Downloads / 下载说明

- ⭐ **Recommended: the .NET 11 package / 推荐使用基于最新 .NET 11 构建的包**
- `1Remote-<version>-net11-x64.zip` — latest .NET 11 / 最新 .NET
- `1Remote-<version>-net10-x64.zip` — .NET 10 LTS / 稳定之选
- `1Remote-<version>-net9-x64.zip` — legacy environments / 旧环境兼容
- `1Remote-<version>-netX-x64-self-contained.zip` — bundles its .NET runtime, nothing to install / 自包含运行时，无需安装 .NET

> Framework-dependent zips (name without "self-contained") require the matching [.NET Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet).
> 非 self-contained 压缩包需要已安装对应版本的 .NET 桌面运行时。
